scripts.dev: turbo run build --filter="./packages/*" && turbo run dev --parallel --filter=!@stay-fable/consumer-miniapp
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs scripts/*.mjs packages/eslint-config/index.mjs && turbo run lint --filter=!@stay-fable/consumer-miniapp
scripts.prisma:generate: node --env-file=.env.example -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const result = spawnSync('pnpm --filter @stay-fable/api-server prisma:generate', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: process.env }); if (result.error) throw result.error; process.exit(result.status ?? 1)"
scripts.check: pnpm verify && pnpm wx:check && pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
